summary: Soft landscaping for a new townhouse site, built to the general contractor's drawings.
plantPalette: Planting to the landscape architect's schedule
scope: Tree and shrub planting to plan
challenge: A general contractor needed soft landscaping finished block by block as each building closed out, to drawings and to the site schedule.
approach: We worked to the landscape drawings and planting schedule, and booked deliveries through the site supervisor so materials never blocked other trades.
At the end of each phase we walked the work with the contractor, listed deficiencies and closed them before moving to the next block.
result: Landscape phases completed to the drawings and handed over with deficiencies closed.
